mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park, and the moon is in a waning gibbous phase.

The city reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all curbside refuse and recycling, and you can use their app or website for schedules. Also, remember that winter alternate-side parking starts on November 20, requiring you to park on even or odd sides of the street depending on the date to ensure snow removal access.
There is plenty to do, including the Main Street Trick-or-Treat today, live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, and the Dane County Farmers' Market happening tomorrow on the Square.
Regarding the police report, on Sunday, October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they found a man asleep behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM with their featured flavor of the day, so make sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
